name: Jon Bonck

accounts.evidence: Jon Bonck's congressional campaign website links to twitter.com/TeamBonck in its social links, alongside instagram.com/teambonck.

notes: Representative-elect, so no official House account exists yet. No separate personal account was linked from the campaign site. Ballotpedia could not be loaded to cross-check.

name: Ben McAdams

accounts.evidence: The page titled 'Ben McAdams for Utah | Official Campaign Website' links to x.com/BenMcAdams along with his campaign Facebook and Instagram.

notes: Linked from the campaign site; it is his name-based long-running account, so labeled personal (it also serves as the campaign account). He likely had an official House account from his 2019-2021 term, but I did not find a page confirming its current handle, so none is listed.

name: Elaine Luria

accounts.evidence: The X icon on the 'Elaine Luria for Congress | Virginia's 2nd District' site points to elaineforcongress.com/twitter, which returns a 301 redirect to twitter.com/ElaineLuria.

notes: Handle taken from the redirect target of her campaign site's X link (elaineluria.com also redirects to elaineforcongress.com). Could be labeled personal as well. Her former official House account from 2019-2023 was not checked and is not listed.

name: Amanda McKinney

accounts.evidence: The 'McKinney for Washington' campaign site (Yakima County commissioner running for Congress) links to x.com/_AmandaMcKinney; iVoterGuide and BallotReady profiles for the WA-4 candidate list the same handle.

notes: Note the leading underscore. amandamckinney.com is an unrelated person's site. Supporting pages: https://ivoterguide.com/candidate/92907 and https://www.ballotready.org/people/amanda-mckinney-64d685c8-d8fb-40d6-811b-b0b0e6bbeb5f. No separate county-commissioner official account was found.
